notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 9 games cover only 33% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 10th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Mavrik Bourque returned in their last game after missing 4 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Jayden Struble joined from MTL on Oct 10 and has played beside Nicolas Hague.
Trevor van Riemsdyk is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 6 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Spencer Stastney has taken his spot beside Kris Letang.
Ben Kindel is on injured reserve and missed their last game.
Egor Chinakhov is out (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward.
Evgeni Malkin is out (illness) and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Ilya Solovyov was added to the roster on Oct 20.
Rutger McGroarty was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Blake Lizotte and Andrei Kuzmenko.
Spencer Stastney is no longer killing penalties: 5% of the team’s shorthanded time in 6 games, down from 31% with his old team last season.
